name: memhop-profile
summary: L0 profile manual: read/update the host identity profile (role, personality, emotion state, MBTI, preferences)
trigger: need to view or adjust the host profile, identity, preferences; profile l0 identity role personality emotion mbti preference

resources.name: GetL0
resources.desc: Read the current L0 profile; returns Name/Role/Personality/EmotionState/MBTI/Preferences

resources.name: UpdateL0
resources.desc: Replace the L0 profile wholesale (full overwrite); omitted fields are cleared, so GetL0 first and fill values back. Preferences is a key-value map; EmotionState carries valence/arousal/dominance and MBTI carries the four i_e/n_s/t_f/j_p dimensions in [-1,1] with a derived type. Dream also evolves personality/emotion_state/mbti, so a host that only wants to change one field must still send the others back unchanged

steps.action: Read current values when profile info is needed or before updating
Overwrite the profile with fully filled-back values
